Name: Timelord Greenhouse
Author: N3rdGirl64
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/0PPnuQJ.png[/img]
Timelords aren't the only ones who can have bigger on the inside technology! With this greenhouse you get to have more space for crops and have a spot for your iridium sprinklers that allow for optimal planting [s]Unless you use other stuffs[/s] and there is spots for trellis crops. The bottom of the greenhouse has been built specially to allow use of any other kind of processing you want/need.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RK7MTYt.png[/img]﻿
Make sure you have Content Patcher installed then drop this mod into your mods folder!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b6c2IjM.png[/img]﻿
This mod will not work with any mod that alters or changes the greenhouse

[img]https://i.imgur.com/prY2LJu.png[/img]﻿
If you have any issues with the mod please make a bug report and include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI Log[/url] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3IoxJ6a.png[/img]﻿
Any custom tiles made by me are free for you to use and edit as you wish.
